critical_code_review_comments: admin_router.require_super_admin Depends is correctly applied to every endpoint; query for reset-password/toggle-active uses {is_super_admin:{$ne:true}} so even a malicious id targeting the super admin returns 404. Solid.
auth_router.google_exchange: super-admin email block lives BEFORE upsert (line ~152), so it's impossible to create a Google-provisioned super admin row. Good defensive ordering.
auth_router.login: deactivated check returns 403 'Account is deactivated' AFTER password verify, which is correct (does not leak existence to attackers without the correct password).
server._seed_super_admin: idempotent and refreshes password_hash + role + active + auth_provider on every startup — matches the 'env-as-source-of-truth' requirement.
server._seed_demo: ENABLE_DEMO_SEED toggle works (default 'true', skipped when 'false'). Good for prod.
GoogleCallback.jsx uses processed.useRef guard to prevent double-exchange under React 18 StrictMode — correct pattern.

AdminDashboard dialog accessibility warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — minor a11y nit, not blocking. Consider adding <DialogDescription> to the reset-password dialog.
AdminRoute guard correctly redirects non-super-admin authenticated users to /app/dashboard (defence in depth — backend already 403s).
